news.dek:
ggml: fix conv_1d result layout for batched input ( #28738 ) 
 
 ggml: fix conv_1d result layout for batched input 
 
 The GEMM behind conv_1d folds the batch into its rows, so the product 
sits in memory as [OL, N, OC] while the reshape claims [OL, OC, N]. 
The shape is right an
news.aiSummary: The ggml library had a bug where the conv_1d operation produced a result layout that did not match the expected reshape for batched input. The underlying GEMM folds the batch dimension into its rows, leaving the product in memory as [OL, N, OC] while the reshape expects [OL, OC, N]. The fix corrects this mismatch so the output layout is consistent with the reshape.
